QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and otherwise forwards the vector. It adds nothing." and "`LlamaCppTokenizer::tokenize` returns `{}` if `vocab_` is null or the second call returns a negative value." and "So failure is indistinguishable from empty input."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired and forwards the tokenizer's `{}` on failure, so the two cases give the same empty value.
